backend: CPU only; no GPU or desktop event processing
after_command_note: One --offline run without --locked reconciled the concurrently introduced local dioxus-desktop 0.7.9 patch; lock diff only removed its registry source/checksum. That package is not a dependency of this benchmark.
boundary: flatten_layer_tree_rgba8 including output/group/raster intermediate allocations, cropping and compositing; excludes fixture creation, warmup, byte comparison, output destruction, PNG encoding, project I/O, queue and physical input/display
sampling: 20 consecutive samples per case before and after; 1 warmup per case excluded; nearest-rank p50/p95/p99; no measured samples removed
limitations: One session each side, separated while independent desktop baseline ran. No desktop benchmark/build overlapped these CPU timings; other system activity and CPU temperature/frequency were not controlled. This is not the export-interference or physical-input gate.
optimization: Blend only visible raster tile/page intersection rows using the unchanged integer source-over function. Retain isolated group buffers and group opacity order. Eliminate one full-page raster temporary and full-page transparent traversal per raster.

validation.same_run_output: Every timed output byte-compared to its untimed warmup
